SELECT p.panemark, p.powratew, perf.measpoww, perf.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'cumdegpct' AS cumdeg, e.soillosspct, i.power_metrics->>'inverteffpct' AS inv_eff

SELECT
  p.panemark,
  p.powratew AS power_rated_w,
  perf.measpoww AS measured_power_w,
  (perf.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'cumdegpct')::numeric AS cum_deg_pct,

FROM panel p
JOIN performance perf ON perf.solmodref = p.panemark
JOIN environment e ON e.arearegistry = p.hubregistry
JOIN inverter i ON i.siteref = p.hubregistry

JOIN environment e ON e.arearegistry = p.hubregistry
